tools.name: find_flipdish_customer_story
tools.description: Search Flipdish customer stories (case studies) by business name or business type. Returns the story title, business type, outlet count, location names and a link to the full story on flipdish.com. Use this to answer questions about which restaurants or takeaways use Flipdish and what results they saw.

query.description: A business name (e.g. "Wasabi") or a business type (e.g. "takeaway", "fast casual", "dark kitchen").

limit.description: Maximum number of stories to return. Default 5, maximum 20.

tools.name: find_flipdish_page
tools.description: Find the canonical flipdish.com page for a Flipdish product, solution, pricing or company topic. Searches the site index published at /llms.txt and returns matching page titles, URLs and descriptions. Use this instead of guessing a URL: Flipdish has country-specific pages and the Spanish site uses Spanish slugs.

query.description: What you are looking for, e.g. "kiosk", "pricing for the UK", "kitchen display system", "careers".

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return. Default 5, maximum 20.
